primary_title: Phosphorylation of FOXO3a on Ser-7 by p38 promotes its nuclear localization in response to doxorubicin
decision_basis: Primary p38 interaction, phosphosite and mutant assays support MAPK14/p38alpha-dependent FOXO3 Ser7 phosphorylation; materialize only at the bounded genotoxic-stress layer.
limitations_preserved: Preserve FOXO3/FOXO3a Ser7, doxorubicin and p38-inhibition context; no SCI or unsupported terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Skp2 inhibits FOXO1 in tumor suppression through ubiquitin-mediated degradation
